groups.sentence: Students do their own thinking, develop their ideas and attempt the assignment before turning to AI.
Students write their own first draft or make an independent attempt before using AI, and do not use AI for that first draft.
Students may use AI to write, revise or summarize only after they have engaged with the work or materials themselves.
Instructors introduce AI engagement only after students have done their own cognitive work, and ask students to edit their own work after using AI.
Students may use AI for pre-task activities such as brainstorming, structuring and idea generation.
